# Yaki - Buy X Get Y & Free Gift

> Shopify app for creating high-converting promotions that increase average order value

**App Store**: https://apps.shopify.com/free-gift-helper  
**Website**: https://gayl-14.online/

## What is Yaki?

Yaki is a Shopify app that helps online merchants increase their average order value (AOV) through strategic promotions and incentives. It enables store owners to create compelling offers like free gifts, Buy X Get Y deals, volume discounts, and tiered rewards that encourage customers to spend more.

## Who is Yaki for?

- **Shopify merchants** looking to boost their average order value
- **E-commerce stores** wanting to reduce cart abandonment
- **Online retailers** seeking to increase customer lifetime value
- **Store owners** who want to run promotions without complex coding
- **Marketing teams** needing flexible, conversion-focused promotion tools

## Key Features

### Promotion Types
- **Free Gift Promotions**: Automatically add free products when customers meet certain conditions (cart value, specific products, collections)
- **Buy X Get Y (BOGO)**: Classic promotions like "Buy 2 Get 1 Free" or "Buy A Get B"
- **Buy More Save More**: Tiered volume discounts that reward higher quantities
- **Spend Tiers**: Offer escalating rewards based on cart value (e.g., spend $50 get free shipping, spend $100 get free gift)
- **Cart Progress Bars**: Visual indicators showing customers how close they are to unlocking rewards

### Gift Management
- **Auto-add gifts**: Automatically add free items to cart when conditions are met
- **Gift popups**: Display attractive popups letting customers choose their free gift
- **Multiple gift options**: Let customers select from various free gift choices
- **Manual or automatic claim**: Choose whether gifts are added automatically or require customer selection

### Targeting & Segmentation
- **Product-based offers**: Trigger promotions based on specific products in cart
- **Collection-based offers**: Create offers targeting entire product collections
- **Customer tag targeting**: Personalize offers for specific customer segments (VIP, loyalty members, etc.)
- **Market-based offers**: Different promotions for different geographic markets
- **Cart value thresholds**: Trigger rewards when cart reaches specific amounts

### Customization
- **Customizable widgets**: Match your store's branding and design
- **Flexible conditions**: Combine multiple rules for sophisticated promotion logic
- **Mobile-optimized**: Works seamlessly on all devices
- **Multi-language support**: Serve international customers

## Common Use Cases

### Increasing Average Order Value
Use tiered promotions to incentivize customers to add more items: "Spend $75 get a free tote bag, spend $100 get a premium gift set"

### Clearing Inventory
Bundle slow-moving products as free gifts with popular items to clear excess stock

### Product Discovery
Introduce customers to new products by offering them as free gifts with purchase

### Seasonal Campaigns
Run holiday promotions like "Buy 2 Get 1 Free on all winter items" during seasonal sales

### Customer Acquisition
Offer attractive first-purchase incentives: "Spend $50 on your first order, get a free welcome gift"

### Upselling Complementary Products
"Buy a phone case, get a screen protector free" to increase relevance and value

### VIP/Loyalty Rewards
Create exclusive offers for tagged customer segments to increase retention

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does Yaki work with all Shopify plans?**
A: Yaki is designed to work with all Shopify plans. Check the Shopify App Store listing for specific compatibility details.

**Q: Can I run multiple promotions at the same time?**
A: Yes, Yaki allows you to run multiple promotion campaigns simultaneously with flexible priority and stacking rules.

**Q: Will promotions work with my theme?**
A: Yaki is designed to integrate seamlessly with standard Shopify themes through customizable widgets.

**Q: Can customers choose their free gift?**
A: Yes, you can configure gift popups that let customers select from multiple free gift options.

**Q: Do promotions work on mobile?**
A: Yes, all promotion displays and widgets are fully optimized for mobile devices.

**Q: Can I target specific customer groups?**
A: Yes, you can target promotions based on customer tags, allowing you to create VIP-only or segment-specific offers.

**Q: How do cart progress bars work?**
A: Progress bars visually show customers how close they are to unlocking rewards (e.g., "$15 away from free shipping"), encouraging them to add more items.

**Q: Can I schedule promotions in advance?**
A: Yaki supports scheduling, allowing you to set up campaigns to start and end automatically at specified times.

**Q: Does this affect my Shopify discounts?**
A: Yaki works alongside Shopify's native discount system and can be configured to stack or prioritize as needed.

**Q: Is there analytics for promotion performance?**
A: Yes, Yaki provides insights into how your promotions are performing and impacting AOV.

4. Preview how promotions appear on your storefront
5. Launch and start increasing your AOV
